fields.description: Use Sandbox with test credentials, Production with live credentials.
fields.label: Environment

fields.options:
Find the App ID and Secret Key in the Cashfree dashboard under Developers → API Keys. Sandbox and Production have different keys.

Saving checks the keys with Cashfree and creates the Cashfree Payment Gateway Account for your default company.

fields.description: Cashfree needs a mobile number for every payment. This number is used when the customer has none (Payment Request, contact on the order or invoice, or Customer).
fields.label: Fallback Customer Mobile

fields.description: On the customer's order page of the Webshop, Pay opens the Cashfree checkout, even when the Webshop checkout uses another gateway (e.g. Cash on Delivery).
fields.label: Use Cashfree for the Webshop Pay Button

fields.options: Add this URL in the Cashfree dashboard under Developers → Webhooks (Payment events). Cashfree only calls HTTPS addresses; without webhooks, payments are still checked when the customer returns and every hour.
